feedback_interpretation: Recent feedback weakened smooth-tail extrapolation. Nearby measurements showed that broad predicted V2 responses can collapse to ordinary values, while selected weak-eluent settings can retain localized late behavior. This batch therefore emphasizes distinct molecule families and varied condition/loading anchors.
batch_rationale: The batch contains exactly 32 distinct candidate IDs and avoids repeating a candidate record. It spans neutral hydrophobes, halogenated aromatics, carbonyls, esters, amino compounds, nitro compounds, alcohols, fused hydrocarbons, and heteroaromatics across strong and weak eluent and multiple loading levels. This coverage should help retraining learn endpoint-specific interpolation, loading response, and structure-condition transfer across the Row-distribution.
